name: atrium
comment:allowScripts: npm will not run a dependency's install/postinstall script unless it is listed
here, pinned to an exact version, so a version bump forces a fresh review.
SECURITY.md T12: an install script is arbitrary code execution on the host,
which is the machine holding every credential. Grant one only with a reason.
esbuild   fetches the platform binary Vite needs. No binary, no build.
node-pty  compiles/downloads the native pty addon. Without it, `require`
throws at runtime and M2's terminal cannot exist at all.
protobufjs dockerode's transitive dep; its postinstall only generates the
CJS/ESM wrapper files that ship in the package.
ssh2      DENIED. Its install.js is an optional `cpu-features` build for a
performance gain on a code path we never take: dockerode pulls
ssh2 in for SSH transport to a remote Docker host, and Atrium
only ever talks to the local engine over a named pipe.
